concerns.text: The plan proposes downloading the full global ERA5 hourly reanalysis dataset for 2014‑2018 (`data/raw/era5_2014_2018.h5`). The raw ERA5 archive for this period is on the order of many terabytes, far exceeding the storage and bandwidth limits of the GitHub Actions free tier (≤7 GB RAM, ≤6 h runtime, limited disk space). This makes the data acquisition and subsequent processing infeasible under the project's free‑compute constraints. Recommend using a spatially‑filtered subset (e.g., only grid cells within the convex hull of Moral Machine locations) or leveraging an on‑demand API that retrieves only the required hourly grid points.
